items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: So we had a fellow like that down in the WPA band. And the one who played in the band at that time was Mr. Martinez.

ctx.x: You couldn't fool him, you know. No, you couldn't fool him. So we had a fellow like that down in the WPA band. And the one who played in the band at that time was Mr. Martinez. You might have heard of him, huh?
